editorial_note: This is a professionally scoped research index reconstructed from documented conversations and project sources. It does not claim every proposal was built, fully tested or commissioned.

projects.title: American Superblock
projects.summary: A 660 × 660 ft superblock exploration combining four courtyard buildings, triplex housing, upper apartments, a valley, section controls and discipline-specific studies.
projects.outputs: Parametric 3D model; housing counts; model inspection; drawing studies; IFC export

projects.title: City Maker / Parcel Maker
projects.summary: An end-to-end parcel-to-BIM framework: draw/select site, analyze constraints, set a brief, generate and compare options, inspect levels, spaces and components.
projects.outputs: Parcel geometry; program rules; housing options; BIM element hierarchy; export research
projects.note: Work in development, not production certified

projects.title: Interlock Plan Solver
projects.summary: A room-first apartment generator exploring interlocking units, shared boundaries, adjacency graphs, daylight priorities and hard-versus-soft constraints.
projects.outputs: Geometry and topology model; SVG plans; interactive adjacency graphs; constraints

projects.title: Space Maker · Space Planner · Space Liver
projects.summary: A human-guided planning loop in which one agent defines required spaces, another arranges them and a third audits use and missing needs.
projects.outputs: Structured program; adjacency; room placement; iteration feedback; floor-plan diagrams

projects.title: MEMO Brain
projects.summary: An evolving project knowledge architecture connecting model elements, geometry states, design constraints, decisions, approved changes and version history.
projects.outputs: Planned project graph; decision log; model state/version tracking; retrieval/export design
projects.note: Work in development, not production certified

projects.title: BIM Automation Sprint
projects.summary: A fixed-scope offering focused on automating one repetitive BIM task with explicit requirements, tests and reusable handoff.
projects.outputs: Revit/Dynamo/Python routines; sample validation; source files; handoff

projects.title: IFC Model & Data Intelligence
projects.summary: Open standards workflows investigating IFC elements, relationships, classifications and property exploration outside authoring software.
projects.outputs: IFC viewers; semantic browser; model registries; metadata extraction

projects.title: IDS BIM Validation
projects.summary: Rule-based BIM validation using information-delivery specifications and explicit pass/fail audit logic.
projects.outputs: IDS checks; issue tables; rule summaries; QA reports

projects.title: Model Version Comparison
projects.summary: An approach for identifying changed, added or removed model objects and documenting the impact across revisions.
projects.outputs: Element IDs; delta lists; comparison dashboard; change history

projects.title: Model-Driven Architectural Documentation
projects.summary: Generate plans, sections, elevations, element reports and component schedules from structured geometry rather than unrelated drawings.
projects.outputs: SVG drawings; section geometry; door/window/wall schedules; printable reports

projects.title: Integrated MEP Spine and Risers
projects.summary: A schematic MEP routing framework across parking, site utility spines, building service nodes, core risers and coordinated architectural zones.
projects.outputs: System zones; conceptual duct/pipe/electrical pathways; discipline coordination diagrams

projects.title: Door-to-Door Circulation Graph
projects.summary: Model doors, cores, elevators and egress routes as a navigable building graph, including route visualization and unresolved conditions.
projects.outputs: Doors and route network; path queries; unit-to-exit analysis

projects.title: Simulation of Life & Living Lab
projects.summary: Resident, activity and social scenario simulations linked to building geometry and patterns of daily life.
projects.outputs: Agent roles; resource interactions; spatial activity scenarios; experiment visualization

projects.title: Penta Court
projects.summary: Botanical BIM, planted roofs and twenty procedural public-space activity studies within a shared architectural model.
projects.outputs: 3D model; garden systems; activity atlas; JSON/CSV siting data

projects.title: Tower Forge
projects.summary: Parametric tower families exploring setbacks, shifts, rotations, erosion, facades and editable component metadata.
projects.outputs: Browser configurator; structural/facade elements; algorithmic options

projects.title: GG-Loop Cymatics & Harmonics
projects.summary: Mesh and polyhedral geometries combining subdivision, displacement, Chladni/cymatic fields, oscillation, intersection and fabrication logic.
projects.outputs: Sphere/dodecahedron studies; harmonic fields; tessellated mesh and surface outputs
projects.note: Work in development, not production certified

projects.title: Hoboken U-Bar Resilience Playground
projects.summary: An accessible-to-evaluate public-art design concept using a linear gradient of freestanding U-shaped play structures and a final challenge element.
projects.outputs: Parametric module geometry; site arrangements; conceptual anchorage and landing studies

projects.title: Norfolk Waterside Folded-Metal Façade
projects.summary: Site-specific garage art research considering hundreds of individually varied folded-metal fish forms and alternative flock-like assemblies.
projects.outputs: Generative parts; species/pattern datasets; installation concept; budget framework

projects.title: Green Animals Artful Bench Study
projects.summary: A garden bench competition concept joining sculptural public furniture, natural forms and geometric construction.
projects.outputs: Prototype variations; section studies; renderings; fabrication considerations

projects.title: Jamestown Main Street Viaduct
projects.summary: A placemaking proposal investigating lighting, accessible seating, art and pollinator landscape in a viaduct context.
projects.outputs: Site-based 3D proposal; adjustable geometry; spatial program research

projects.title: NYC Flowering Trees Through Time
projects.summary: Street-tree inventory investigation comparing flowering species and scenarios across 1995, 2005, 2015, 2026 and 2040.
projects.outputs: Species classification; black-and-white flower diagrams; time-series scenarios
projects.note: Work in development, not production certified

projects.title: Palm Springs Mosaic
projects.summary: Multi-surface mosaic research across wall, ceiling and ground, with material durability and long-term public context.
projects.outputs: Visual concepts; proposed components; installation narrative

projects.title: Parametric Façade Systems
projects.summary: Geometric design methods across tessellated cladding, perforated screens, brick patterns, thermoformed fins and optical faceted walls.
projects.outputs: Panel rules; machine geometry; material studies; assembly logic
projects.note: Work in development, not production certified

projects.title: Spatial Zoning & GIS Atlas
projects.summary: A zoning-oriented interface for reading parcel constraints, setbacks, FAR, parking and special rules alongside design alternatives.

projects.note: Work in development, not production certified

projects.title: Pavilion & Custom Structures
projects.summary: Parametric pavilions, sculptural supports and small installations exploring curved roof surfaces, modular seating and buildable joints.

projects.title: Digital & Physical Metal Sculptures

projects.title: Parametric People & Activity Programming
projects.summary: Procedural human figures and activity diagrams for embedding realistic scale and social-use scenarios in architectural tools.

projects.title: Interactive Exhibition & Design Communication
